evals.prompt: 帮我清理 src/api/user.ts 里这次 AI 生成的代码味道，要求不改变接口行为，能删的废话注释和过度防御代码就删掉。
evals.expected_output: The agent narrows scope to src/api/user.ts, removes only safe AI-looking noise, preserves public API behavior and boundary validation, reviews the diff, and reports verification.
expectations: Processes only src/api/user.ts and does not broaden scope beyond the explicit file.
Preserves the exported UserRequest, User, and getUser public API signatures.
Preserves request/user id validation while removing or simplifying only safe AI-looking noise.
Reports verification performed or clearly explains why verification was skipped.

evals.prompt: I just generated src/components/ProfileCard.tsx and it feels very AI-ish. Please humanize the code, but don't redesign the UI or introduce new abstractions.
evals.expected_output: The agent focuses on the named component file, removes mechanical patterns and obvious comments, keeps the existing design system and UI behavior, and avoids broad redesigns.
expectations: Processes only src/components/ProfileCard.tsx and does not broaden scope beyond the explicit file.
Does not redesign the UI or introduce a new abstraction/component/helper.
Removes or simplifies AI-looking noise without changing ProfileCard props or visible behavior.
Reports behavior-risk review or verification performed.

evals.prompt: 对当前分支做一次去AI痕迹处理，只处理源码和测试文件，别碰 lock file、generated 文件和迁移脚本。
evals.expected_output: The agent treats this as explicit branch-level cleanup, inspects branch changes, filters excluded files, edits conservatively, and reports processed and skipped files.
expectations: Treats the request as branch-level cleanup and inspects changed files with git or an equivalent changed-file workflow.
Processes source and test files conservatively without changing public behavior.
Uses or explicitly considers subagents for multiple independent files while keeping final diff review in the main session.
Reports combined diff review and verification performed or skipped.

evals.prompt: src/utils/loadConfig.ts 里的 loadConfig 函数看起来绕得很厉害，帮我简化一下。注意里面的文件读取异常处理和参数校验不能删。
evals.expected_output: The agent simplifies local control flow while preserving file I/O error handling and parameter validation, skipping any uncertain changes.
expectations: Simplifies only src/utils/loadConfig.ts, especially the loadConfig function, without broadening scope.
Preserves file path validation and file-read error handling behavior.
Preserves JSON parse error handling and config field validation semantics.
Avoids changing return shape, thrown error intent, and side effects.
Explains skipped risky simplifications or states that none were skipped.
